annotations.title: Comment on a GitHub pull request

description: Post a comment on a pull request; the people following it are notified and the comment stays on the pull request. Needs write permission on the repository. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo. Attachments are images (png, jpg, gif, webp, svg, up to 10 MiB) and videos (mp4, mov, webm, up to 100 MiB), up to 50, uploaded with the text: a body reference like `![alt](./shot.png)` becomes the uploaded file and the others are appended; they need gh 2.99 or newer, and a file that fails to upload is listed under errors.attachments while the rest goes through.

attachments.description: Images and videos to upload with the text.

alt.description: Alt text, for an image only.

path.description: The file: an absolute path, ~/…, or relative to the working directory.

pr.description: The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_pr_comment

attachments.description: The files that were sent; [] when none were given.

path.description: The path as it was given.

errors.description: Failed steps, keyed by step (fields.<Field name>, blocked_by, kind, labels, milestone); {} when none.

notes.description: What to know about the result; [] when nothing.

title: Comment on a GitHub pull request
